scope: Input requirements for a conditional drying benchmark, not runtime parameters
proposed_minimum_outputs: total specimen mass over main drying
IR surface measurement under documented observation operator
not_automatically_predicted: shrinkage if observed geometry is prescribed
interior temperature from a single surface reading
sintering chemistry or final brick strength
law_level: Conservation relations and positive-dissipation requirements are universal constraints; material closures and actualboundaryconditions remain unqualified.

inputs.required: Individual hole positions, wall thicknesses, length-axis mapping confirmation and accessible/support-contact faces.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Obtain dimensioned original drawing and identify which face was supported/ventilated; do not invent a CAD mesh.

inputs.required: A complete compatible deformation map F(X,t) and interpolation error if using a movingdomain; independent shrinkage law if claiming prediction.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Choose explicitly between prescribing observed geometry and predicting deformation. Neither is implemented; prescribed observed geometry cannot be used to claim independent shrinkage prediction.

inputs.available: Initial7.316kg and operational drymass6.252kg from nomenclature/C.1; previous source review applies.
inputs.required: Dry-solid mass stability and operational100C reference versus physically boundwater; initial moisture distribution.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Keep rawmass and dryreference protocol. Ask for preparation/history/distribution information; no homogeneous field by default.

inputs.required: Internal initial temperature distribution or evidence that uniforminitialT approximation satisfies targeterror.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Request storage/equilibration history and internalT measurements if available; no centerT substitution.
Request same-run logs and chamber/sampleplacement. Tablemeans are not measuredboundaryhistories.

inputs.available: Mass and surfaceT observations only; general waterreference available elsewhere cannot substitute claymatrix/boundwater properties.
inputs.required: Same-material sensible and binding/phasechangeenergy asfunctionofT,w; common energyreference and uncertainty.
inputs.source_locator: No applicable samebatch closure established in this stage.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Identify independent same-material calorimetry/source and validitydomain before choosing U(T,w).

inputs.required: Same-material conductivity tensor or justifiedscalarclosure, anisotropy, porosity dependence and measurementuncertainty.
inputs.source_locator: No applicable closure established in this stage.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Find existing samebatch conductivity measurement; otherwise make this a specific materialcharacterization request.

inputs.available: Dimensional mass trajectory; authorM_e has a different formula from ordinary endpointdrybasis.
inputs.required: A thermodynamically consistent total-water or liquid/vaporflux closure; sorption/capillarity and transport coefficients with domains and independentcalibration.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Specify required potential/flux model before acquiring parameters. Fitted sourcecoefficients or reportedM_e cannot self-validate.

inputs.required: Separate exterior/channel heat/moisturetransfer or resolvedairdomain; radiative properties and contacts where relevant.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Do not turn A0* with unit1/length into anarea or substitute macrovoidfraction for epsilon. Request floworientation/exposedsurface information.

inputs.required: Exact spot/face, emissivity, spot-size, delay andcalibration; mappingfrommodeledTfieldtoreportedreading.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Request pointdefinition and measurement protocol before selecting a simulatednode.

inputs.available: Published measurementtables and instrumentdescriptions; no complete errorbudget.
inputs.required: Calibration, correlations, rounding, repeats and batchvariability.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Preserve decimalprecision separately frommeasurementuncertainty; do not assign anexperimentalaccuracythreshold from numericalrounding.

inputs.required: Predeclared outputs/domain/error metrics and independent conditions/specimens for validation aftermodelchoices.
inputs.acquisition_or_decision: Freeze a justified validation protocol before prediction; do not call these source-consistency matches materialvalidation.
